programs.description: A group of friends on vacation in Darjeeling agree to help a scientist protect his valuable formula from a Japanese spy. However, they soon suspect that all may not be as it seems.
A man gives shelter to a girl who has been a victim of rape and has also witnessed a murder. He gives her hope to live again, and they fall in love with each other.
After adopting the name Tiger, Indrajit Sen, a grief-stricken college professor, decides to fight corrupt public servants and avenge his son's death.
A powerful man kidnaps Haripada, a common man, and forces him to pretend to be his girlfriend's lover so that he can mislead his suspicious and jealous wife.
Ajit Singh is the leader of a night guard party in a town in Punjab and lives with his wife, son and daughter. He and his family get killed by a terrorist leader.
Teenagers enjoy their school life to the fullest, until a boy gets murdered in a classroom, and everyone in the institution comes under the radar of suspicion.
Strangers Sudarshan and Kuntol cross paths and talk about the upheavals in their lives and come up with strange solutions that have unreal consequences.
Rajarshi, an internationally renowned director, comes to Kolkata for a short sabbatical and reunites with the people he had left behind in life to pursue filmmaking.
Under an enormous debt, Bhupati Ray strives to sell his inherited palace while withholding its paranormal truth. Upon finding a buyer, one of his ancestors' ghosts creates a chaotic hurdle.
Sohini, a Bengali woman, gets married to Ashwin, a man from another community. When they feel lost in their lives, they decide to understand each other's perspectives.
Meher Ali, a Muslim boy who lives with his widowed mother, falls in love with a Hindu girl. However, his life turns upside down when he gets convicted as a terrorist and imprisoned for life.

After being harassed by his family members, a retired teacher decides to teach them a lesson in order to discipline them.
A young couple must overcome internal conflicts and a series of problems that arise due to a criminal accusation in order to be united in love.
